The '''Security Droid GH-11''' was a powerful [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] that was stationed in the assembly line of the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it was destroyed by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces that invaded the factory.

==Behind the scenes==
The Security Droid GH-11 appears as a bonus boss in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where it can be found by activating a computer terminal in the Assembly Line of the Okara Droid Factory&mdash;a Heroic area in the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
